original_description: Activate a session guardrail that blocks file edits outside apps/learn-app/docs/. Use this skill when starting a focused content editing session to prevent accidental changes to platform code, configs, or other non-content files. Invoke with "/content-lock" when you want to protect the codebase during content-only work. Also useful when multiple agents are working and you want to scope one to content only.
best_description: Activate a session guardrail that blocks file edits outside apps/learn-app/docs/. Use this skill when starting a focused content editing session to prevent accidental changes to platform code, configs, or other non-content files. Invoke with "/content-lock" when you want to protect the codebase during content-only work. Also useful when multiple agents are working and you want to scope one to content only.
final_description: Invoke this skill — do NOT just promise to be careful — when the user asks you to only edit docs, stay in the docs folder, restrict edits to lesson/content files, lock the session to apps/learn-app/docs/, or avoid touching platform/config/infrastructure code. Users often phrase this as safety ("don't accidentally edit anything else") or scope ("scope to content only", "can only edit docs/"). This skill installs an actual enforcement hook that blocks Edit/Write outside apps/learn-app/docs/. Self-enforcement is unreliable; this hook is the correct mechanism. Skip for: normal content editing without restriction requests, branch protection, API rate limits, or sessions needing both content and code changes.

history.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to lock down, restrict, or scope file edits to content files only (apps/learn-app/docs/). Trigger phrases include: "stay in docs", "only edit docs", "restrict edits to docs", "lock to content only", "don't touch platform code", "scope to content", "lock down everything else", or any request to prevent editing files outside the docs directory during a session. This installs a session guardrail hook that blocks Edit and Write operations on any file outside apps/learn-app/docs/. Do NOT trigger for: normal content editing without restriction requests, branch protection, API rate limits, read-only modes for end users, or sessions that need both content and platform code changes.
